title: Unify paragraph styles by tags
goal: Use an element selector to set the same style for two training room opening times.
summary: element selector writes HTML tag name directly. The browser will apply this rule to all similar elements on the page.
tasks: Use element selector p to select two opening times.
Set the text color to #125a46 and the font size to 18px. The page title remains in its original color.
hint: Write p in the selector, and then write the color and font size in curly brackets. If the title also changes color, check to see if its ancestor is selected by the selector.

example.note: works album uses figcaption to mark the description under each picture. This element selector allows all image captions to use the same font size and color.
